name: Brodie
source:
Pupula Duplex's spunky and handsome founder, drummer, and Leila’s identical twin. The old house's mysteries are no match for Brodie's relentless optimism, but he's too airheaded to figure out any of the answers himself. Still, he'll keep the rest of the band happy!

[From [url=https://watercress.itch.io/hhor]official profile[/url]]
